title: Logged model search order_by: model_id asc is appended as the final key unless the caller already orders by model_id
answers: Why are logged model search results in a different order across pages when user sort keys tie?
How do I sort logged models by model_id without a duplicate ORDER BY term?
Where are the default trailing sort keys for search_logged_models added?
body:
Path: Logged-model search ordering built from the caller's order_by list (metrics.<name>, creation_timestamp, model_id, and other logged model fields) runs through mlflow/store/tracking/sqlalchemy_store.py:SqlAlchemyStore._apply_order_by_search_logged_models, which appends default trailing keys after the user's clauses.
Rule: After the user's keys, the method appends creation_timestamp_ms desc only when no creation_timestamp key was supplied (has_creation_timestamp), and model_id asc only when no model_id key was supplied (has_model_id, detected via SqlLoggedModel.ALIASES). This makes paginated results deterministic when user keys tie, without repeating a key the caller already set.
Symptom: (convention, no user-facing symptom recorded)
Constraints: Applies to search_logged_models ordering only. When the caller sorts by model_id, the explicit key is the only model_id term; the test test_search_logged_models_order_by_model_id_does_not_duplicate_tiebreaker asserts the compiled ORDER BY shape.
applies: Ordering of search_logged_models results in the SQL tracking store, including pagination determinism for ties.
says: Model search results shift order unpredictably across pages when their primary sort values tie.
Make model listing pagination deterministic whenever multiple models share the same creation date.
Ensure paginated model search maintains consistent row ordering when custom sort fields have ties.
search: SqlAlchemyStore._apply_order_by_search_logged_models appends creation_timestamp_ms desc and model_id asc as default trailing tiebreakers unless those keys were already supplied. This ensures deterministic pagination across tied user sort keys without duplicating explicit model_id or creation_timestamp clauses in the compiled SQL ORDER BY. It applies specifically to search_logged_models ordering in the SQL tracking store.
